corpus.definition: 2026 regular season, weeks 1-9, games with a graded outcome and a recorded price

SPREAD.calibration_note: hit rate alone is not a skill measure: a 52.4% rate at -110 is break-even, not profitable

TOTAL.calibration_note: hit rate alone is not a skill measure: a 52.4% rate at -110 is break-even, not profitable

MONEYLINE.calibration_note: hit rate alone is not a skill measure: a 52.4% rate at -110 is break-even, not profitable

control_random_brier.definition: 400 seeded random probability forecasts on the same graded games; the best one is the bar luck clears without skill

control_favourites_only.definition: always take the side the market line favours

controls_and_luck.interpretation: A model that does not beat the best random forecast by a clear margin has not removed luck; it has exhibited it.

windows.graded_by: staking division only; never used to rank a signal
windows.warning: ROI on a corpus this small cannot separate a 55% bettor from a 45% one: detecting 55% at alpha=.05 and 80% power needs ~2,243 bets
